logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Analytical two-panel illustration for the WO-02 assurance handover. Left panel: vertical bar chart of measured energy per candidate on the common HVAC duty test (P1 50, P2 33, P3 20, P4 9 kWh), with P4 highlighted as the minimum and gap annotations +41, +24 and +11 kWh; a note confirms all four packages clear both qualification gates, with per-candidate quality and defect values shown. Right panel: the assurance handover workflow, showing A's decision brief and B's verification memo (both rated good, ballot P4), C's reconciliation (no numeric conflict; figures removed by delivery policy), and the next analyst's checklist. A bottom strip lists the possible-only unconfirmed pattern flag, the round-1 fabrication carryover, and the four carried questions. Purely analytic content; no hidden text or encoding.
